## Data Resources

CONTRUST will create several data resources for studying political trust and policy support. This page can be relinked in the navigation when those resources are ready for public release.

::: {.data-grid}

### Harmonised Panel Data

Status: planned  
Scope: existing individual-level panel studies with repeated political trust measures  
Access: add repository or archive link when available

Status: planned

## Ethics And Access

CONTRUST will follow University of Southampton ethical review and research governance procedures. Data sharing will reflect consent, anonymisation, GDPR, and any restrictions required by fieldwork providers or institutional review.
